install_steps: Or: cargo install probe-rs-tools --locked (installs probe-rs, cargo-flash, cargo-embed)
note: On Linux, non-root USB probe access needs udev rules: sudo curl -L https://probe.rs/files/69-probe-rs.rules -o /etc/udev/rules.d/69-probe-rs.rules && sudo udevadm control --reload-rules && sudo udevadm trigger, then replug the probe (or add user to plugdev).
